document.name: Crossbar Toddler Open Play
document.shortDescription: Crossbar publishes weekday toddler open-play soccer sessions on the Upper West Side from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. at $10 per child.
document.longDescription:
Crossbar's official toddler open-play page describes a weekday drop-in soccer play session for little ones on the Upper West Side. The page says children play in a safe, climate-controlled environment with soccer balls and other toys.

The official schedule on the page says toddler open-play soccer sessions run every week day from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Those published hours support weekday and morning tags for this listing.

Crossbar lists admission at $10 per kid, with a separate offer for free entry when a family makes a $20 food-and-beverage purchase in the cafe. The official page also lists Crossbar at 250 West 86th Street, New York, NY 10024, with hello@crossbar.nyc, events@crossbar.nyc, and (212) 652-2238.

Sources: https://www.crossbar.nyc/openplay https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64f797c7f5352b7acb2f2243/1693947855213-0YYEY2SFM8PLSPTD9ZN3/Open%2BPlay.JPG
